topic.title: Manifold Learning and Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction
topic.area: Sparsity, Low-Rank Models, and Dimensionality Reduction
topic.overview: High-dimensional observations may vary along a much smaller set of meaningful directions. Manifold learning seeks a compact representation that preserves relevant local or global geometry. This topic studies nonlinear encoders, neighborhood constraints, kernel embeddings, random projections, and the optimization difficulties that arise when unfolding complex data.
topic.whyItMatters: A low-dimensional picture can help organize variation, but preserving nearby distances does not guarantee preservation of every task-relevant distinction. Reconstruction, classification, and visualization can favor different embeddings. Applying manifold ideas to model parameters also requires testing whether the assumed structure corresponds to useful behavior.
topic.evolution: A 1992 encoder-decoder method penalizes hidden activity to encourage compact representations. A 2004 kernel-learning approach preserves local angles and distances while maximizing feature-space variance. Later work examines non-isometric embeddings and local minima; a 2026 proposal compresses parameter clusters onto learned manifolds and applies conditional diffusion to repair degraded models.
openQuestions: Which geometric properties should an embedding preserve for a specific downstream task?
How can learned manifolds be validated when the underlying low-dimensional structure is unknown?

papers.tldr: InfoGlobe compresses single-cell RNA measurements through functional gene groups while preserving statistical geometry and improving biological structure in reported benchmarks.

papers.title: Learning Manifold Data with Flow Matching
papers.tldr: A decomposition of motion along and off a data manifold yields tighter learning bounds for flow-matching transformers.

papers.title: nD-RoPE: A Generalized RoPE for n-Dimensional Position Embedding
papers.tldr: nD-RoPE generalizes rotary position embeddings through coupled multidimensional geometry and improves performance across images, videos, and point clouds.

papers.title: Parameter Manifold Purification
papers.tldr: Parameter Manifold Purification compresses and denoises parameter clusters to restore degraded models, including unseen models in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Rethinking Federated Prompt Learning for Medical Images: From Textual Tuning to Visual Manifold Anchoring
papers.tldr: FedMAP uses a shared LLM-derived codebook to restructure medical-image features and align class relationships across federated clients.

papers.title: Trajectory Seriation via Spectral Tangent Alignment and Global Embedding
papers.tldr: STAGE aligns local curve directions and integrates their displacements to recover a global ordering of noisy points.
